    Home

    Deutsche Telekom Christmas campaign: Take time to connect

    Christmas brings people together, but a gathering does not always mean we are truly present with one another.

    More information

    For media professionals

    Information and downloadable materials from Deutsche Telekom for media professionals.

    More information

    • Investor Relations

      Here you will find all the information on investor relations.

      Investor Relations

    • Reasons to invest in Deutsche Telekom shares

      An attractive dividend, the Group’s competitiveness, and strong market positions are just some of the reasons to invest in the company.

      Reasons to invest in Deutsche Telekom shares

    • Publications

      Here you can find all Investor Relations publications.

      Publications

    Careers at Telekom

    Find current job openings and helpful information about applying and starting your career with us.

    Visit the careers website

    • Online Shop

      Discover products and offers for your home and on the go in our Online Shop.

      Online Shop

    • Telekom Customer Portal

      All information about your personal data with us

      Telekom Customer Portal

    • Contact customer service

      Find the best way to reach us in just a few steps!

      Contact customer service

    Latest news

    Visit the newsroom
    • AI B2B Digital Companies

      Telekom expands AI factory in Munich

      More computing power for artificial intelligence. Deutsche Telekom will further expand its AI factory in Munich's Tucherpark.

      Learn more
    • Finance

      More growth, raised guidance, record dividend

      Deutsche Telekom remains on course in the third quarter

      Learn more

    • Reusing network equipment together

      Telekom Equipment Exchange enables excess network equipment to be exchanged across countries. This reduces costs, emissions, and supply dependencies.

      Learn more
    Visit the newsroom

    Facts about Telekom

    Around 200,000 employees work for Telekom in more than 50 countries worldwide. This makes the Group one of the larger international telecommunications providers, with a strong global presence in Europe and the United States.

    As of: 31 December 2025 | Source: Group Profile 2026

    Telekom ranks 11th worldwide in the "Brand Finance Global 500" ranking. It is also the world's most valuable telecommunications brand and the only European company in the top 20.

    As of: 20 January 2026 | Source: Brand Announcement 2026

    Topics to explore

    Visit our topic hubs

    Networks

    Every year, we invest several billion euros in network expansion so we can continue to offer our customers the best network in the future.
